summary: Strict layered separation: Layer A = storage byte order (mechanical facts only); Layer B = naming/directory/resource-role HYPOTHESES (each item evidence-graded); Layer C = Source 1 conversion-design candidates (explicitly NOT recovered CF facts).

evidence_grade_legend.STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED: Mechanical structural fact, reproducible by deterministic decode of the file
evidence_grade_legend.OBSERVED: Direct observation of byte/value/field, not interpreted
evidence_grade_legend.DIFFERENTIAL_SUPPORTED: Same byte-pattern metric varies systematically across a same-family sample set
evidence_grade_legend.STRONG_HYPOTHESIS: Strong but still unproven working hypothesis
evidence_grade_legend.HYPOTHESIS: Possibly true, but no consumer/contract evidence yet
evidence_grade_legend.SOURCE1_DESIGN_CANDIDATE: Conversion-design choice for Source 1 mapping; NOT a recovered CF fact
evidence_grade_legend.OPEN_UNRESOLVED: No evidence yet, deliberately not claimed
evidence_grade_legend.VERIFIED_CORPUS_STATISTIC: Empirical statistic over the local corpus (NOT universal)
